text.title: FreshDrop, grocery delivery in Moscow, Q3 2026
text.opportunities: office districts go remote: more home deliveries; 2 new metro lines
text.threats: Kuper cuts prices 15%; courier wages rising in Moscow
text.strengths: 2-hour delivery in 80% of districts; 98% on time in June
text.weaknesses: narrow range: 4 000 items vs 12 000 at rivals
text.so: use the on-time record to win remote-office families with a weekly plan
text.st: match Kuper prices on 200 staple items using our stock data
text.wo: use the new metro lines to add 10 dark-store pickup points
text.wt: cut low-margin categories; stop non-food delivery in 2 districts
